description: This file defines CMake functions to perform regex-based string operations, such as matching and replacing substrings within variables. It includes a primary function `string_take_regex` to match a regex at the start of a string and optionally return the match, as well as a faster version `string_take_regex_replace` that combines matching and replacement. The file is used for text processing within CMake build scripts.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Matches a regex at the beginning of a specified variable's value, shortens the variable to remove the matched part, and optionally returns the matched string.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs a regex match at the start of a variable, then replaces the matched part with a specified replacement string. It utilizes `string_take_regex` internally.
